metaTitle: Free IT Services Invoice Template — No Signup, No Watermark
metaDescription: Free IT services invoice template for MSPs, consultants, and tech support — no signup, no watermark. Download editable Word and PDF, or make one online.
intro: This is a free IT services invoice template for managed service providers, IT consultants, and freelance tech support who bill for support hours, project work, and recurring plans. It gives you a clean line-item layout with room for a ticket or project reference, so a client can see exactly which work and which hours they are paying for.

It is completely free, with no signup and no watermark. Download the editable Word and PDF files and fill them in on your own computer, or use the generator below to build your invoice in the browser and download a print-ready PDF in minutes.
included: Line items for billable support hours, project work, and hardware or software, so a client sees labor and pass-through costs on separate lines
A ticket, project, or service-period reference field, so each invoice ties back to a specific job or a monthly managed-services plan
A header for your business name, logo, address, and contact details, and a section for the client you are billing
A unique invoice number with issue and due dates so each invoice is easy to track and reference
Automatic subtotal, tax, and grand total, plus a notes and payment-terms area for retainers, monthly plans, or Net 30
Free editable Word and PDF files, print-ready on one page, with no watermark and no signup

steps.title: Add your business, client, and service details
steps.body: Enter your company name, logo, and contact info at the top, then add the client and a ticket, project, or billing-period reference. Give the invoice a unique number and set the issue and due dates.

steps.title: List your hours, projects, and hardware
steps.body: Add each line with a description, quantity or hours, and rate — for example support hours at your hourly rate, a fixed project fee, or a monthly managed-services plan. The template adds up line totals, subtotal, tax, and the grand total for you.

steps.title: Download and send
steps.body: Download a print-ready PDF (or the editable Word file) and email it to your client. Include your payment terms — a monthly retainer, a project deposit, or Net 30 — and how you want to be paid.

faqs.q: How do I bill support hours and a fixed project fee on the same IT invoice?
faqs.a: Use separate line items. Put each block of support hours with its quantity and hourly rate on its own line, then add the fixed-fee project as a single line with a flat amount. List any hardware or software you passed through as their own lines. The template totals everything into one subtotal, adds tax, and shows a single grand total, so the client sees the full cost and the breakdown behind it.

faqs.q: Can I use this template for a monthly managed-services retainer?
faqs.a: Yes. Set one line for the monthly plan or retainer with the flat amount, and add extra lines for any out-of-scope work or overage hours that month. Note the service period in the reference field, give each month's invoice a new invoice number, and set the terms you agreed on, such as Net 15 or Net 30.

faqs.q: Should I charge sales tax on IT services?
faqs.a: It depends on your state and what you are selling. In the U.S., many professional services are not taxed, but some states tax specific IT services, and reselling hardware or software often is taxable. The template has a tax line that calculates automatically; set the rate that applies to you, and check your state's rules if you are unsure. This is general information, not tax advice.

faqs.q: Is the template really free with no watermark?
faqs.a: Yes. The Word and PDF files are free to download and use, with no signup and no watermark. You can reuse them for every client and project and edit them however you like.
